record.question: The United Nations has declared which date as Nelson Mandela day?
record.explanation: Answer A: July 18. UN General Assembly resolution 64/13 designates 18 July as Nelson Mandela International Day, beginning in 2010. Reference: https://www.un.org/pga/73/wp-content/uploads/sites/53/2019/07/A-RES-64-13.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
